title: Certify 62 canonical single-warp entrance outcomes (no κ)
body:
## Summary

A source-bound finite certificate settles the canonical single-entrance experiment for all 62 native events strictly after warp index 13 in PR3929's staged base word, answering unpaidmoon's PR4163 handoff. This contribution was produced by Nick Petalas.

```text
62 later events
  10 have no legal entrance enlargement
  52 have exactly one
     2 canonical completions preserve the paid histogram
    50 strictly increase every r^q tariff, 0<q<1
```

All maximal capacities have dimension five. Equal-price indices are 31 and 40. The capacity result permits every legal suffix assignment above the original floors; the price result concerns only canonical least completions. No new kappa or selected-frontier change is claimed.

[Proof and scope](https://github.com/petalas/integer-mult-bounds/blob/99b6564e1f4d1cf83bd42dc2ffafb1a4465231cc/research/remaining-warp-entrances/README.md), [advance CLAIM](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19373518).

Credit unpaidmoon/PR4163 for the question; ToikY/PR3933 for backward capacities and least closure; Dugongue/PR3929 for the word and transported-frame construction; Sagar Thakrar/PR3687 and Arham Tahir for the retained frame semantics; dataisfire, zxv, Ross Richardson, Jeremy Kothe, Cinna Davis, Tekalign and the retained native/owner/compiler lineage. Binary elimination and concavity are classical. The new contribution is the remaining-event certificate and its price classification, rather than an audit of its predecessors.

## Evidence and reproduction

Before, the later 62 events were unpriced in the cited handoff. After, point-set and annihilator capacity calculations agree on all 62, all 52 new completions have complete frame bills, and every nonzero histogram belongs to an explicitly proved positive power-price class.

Both warning-strict CPython 3.12.15 modes pass in 16.265 and 16.321 seconds locally, with byte-identical complete generated receipts. These times establish timeout headroom, not a speedup. Checks preserve every ordered nonidentity operation, original frame floor, caller field, helper width, entrance/terminal climb and rank mass. Nineteen rejection controls include four altered-source byte checks, illegal seeds, a wrong transported exit and an omitted paid climb.

From the repository root:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/remaining-warp-entrances/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -O -B research/remaining-warp-entrances/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/remaining-warp-entrances
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/remaining-warp-entrances --check-source-history
```

Another CPython 3.12 executable may replace the local path. Standard library only. Direct replay prints `PASS_REMAINING_WARP_ENTRANCES no_new_kappa`; registered replay prints `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`. Each registered command has a 180-second timeout. Metadata, source pins, committed bytes/source ancestry, whitespace and function-bound checks pass. The official ten-file payload export passes integrity checks. A sealed read-only Git-free optimized replay with empty PATH reproduces the direct stdout and leaves all eleven exported files unchanged, including its manifest. Receipts are generated on stdout and bind every package/input hash.

## Limitations and unrun obligations

This fixes the old staged word, one enlarged entrance, its earlier prefix, maps/order, original frame floors and terminal caps. The capacity theorem is the cited predecessor contract. The authenticated frame bill and cleanup routines are explicit reused dependencies; no predecessor verification entry point is executed. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

The price exclusion covers canonical least completions. Least frames need not be cheapest frames. Physical native phases, owner/idle fills, ordinary tape/precision costs, compiler closure, stock and analytic recovery remain open. All five selected assumptions remain. No selected scientific cold replay, Lean or Docker run was performed. This is neither supplier admission nor a complete multiplication theorem.

## Open next questions

- Optimize larger legal suffix frames for one of the 52 seeds, beginning with indices 31 or 40, and price every transition. An attaining word and its native/owner contract remain blockers.
- Test one joint pair of entrance changes against its terminal constraints and full histogram. The single-seed result supplies no additivity theorem or favorable joint budget.

## Related open work

No open PR found in the refreshed source-number, transported-entrance and local-claim searches studies this exact 62-event canonical domain. PR5693's general coframe handoff and PR5698's restricted-C optimum are merged work on different source contracts. Sparse historical notes, arbitrary diffs and unpublished work remain overlap limits. No extra computations rechecked another contribution.

The completion refresh inspected all thirteen open account PRs created since the advance CLAIM, including this PR. The other twelve study different objects or contracts; none computes this same 62-event canonical domain or a competing common value. No additional computations rechecked another contribution.

## CI notes

Both hosted checks passed at exact head `99b6564e1f4d1cf83bd42dc2ffafb1a4465231cc` in [run 41635712286](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/41635712286): [plan](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/41635712286/job/125916244221) and [replay (research/remaining-warp-entrances)](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/41635712286/job/125918425120). The completed check list was read once; run metadata confirms completed success and the matching head. All registered commands also passed locally, along with metadata, committed-byte/source-history and export-integrity checks. Hosted replay certifies execution of the declared finite checks; independent human and formal proof-kernel acceptance remain unclaimed.

## Merge danger

Door: two-way. Blast radius: isolated. Six files in one new opt-in research package; shared code and frozen source bytes are unchanged.
